self.text: Hey there! I’m Oren, a mid‑twenties Aussie who loves a good photo walk. I’m all about a relaxed stroll with a fast pace—so let’s keep the momentum going while we snap some cool shots. I carry just a phone for gear, so no debates over equipment—just the moment. When it comes to post‑processing, I’m happy to share what I know and teach a few tricks if you’re interested. I’m free most weekday evenings, so we can plan a sunset walk or a quick cityscape session after work. Outside the camera, I’m a chillie grower, which means I appreciate good food and a relaxed vibe. I’m looking forward to connecting with someone who’s up for a relaxed yet energetic photo adventure. Let’s capture some memories together!
